629:t_007:3.en:
$$レド$$
「I want to protect their songs.」

629:t_007:5.en:
$$レド$$
「I feel like I first learned what a song is after coming to Earth.」

629:t_007:6.en:
$$レド$$
「It's not just a string of sounds, or vibrations in the air... I think it's life itself.」

629:t_007:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「So you do get it, $$レド$$.」

629:t_007:8.en:
$$レド$$
「And I... if we can come to understand each other, I have no intention of fighting those $$バジュラ$$.」

629:t_007:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「In the $$人類銀河同盟$$, the $$バジュラ$$ are a hostile species ranked alongside the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

629:t_007:10.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm no longer a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$. And the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ aren't our enemy either, if the truth is what it seems.」

629:t_007:11.en:
$$レド$$
「So I'm going to protect their song! I want to help them try to stop a fight with someone we have no need to fight!」

629:t_007:12.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't ever want to feel the way I did back with the $$クジライカ$$ again...」

629:t_007:14.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, this is a surprise... Who'd have thought $$レド$$, of all people, would try to communicate with a life form they call $$バアル$$.」

629:t_007:16.en:
$$クラン$$
「No words are needed! You spoke for all of us!」

629:t_007:17.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I don't dislike it, you know. That kind of romantic way of thinking.」

629:t_007:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. This unit is likewise no longer under the Alliance's control.」

629:t_007:20.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit will act on the judgment of the human, Ensign $$レド$$.」

629:t_007:22.en:
$$アル$$
「A partnership between human and machine. How wonderful.」

629:t_007:23.en:
$$アル$$
「Above all, Ensign $$レド$$'s growth as a human being amazes even me.」

629:t_007:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「For the record, I'm making the same call as $$レド$$.」

629:t_007:25.en:
$$アル$$
「So am I. I can't allow anyone to disturb the precious duet of $$シェリル・ノーム$$ and $$ランカ・リー$$.」

629:t_007:27.en:
$$アル$$
「Their songs are pleasant even to me, an AI.」

629:t_007:28.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Lending you my $$シェリル$$ discs from my collection really paid off.」

629:t_007:29.en:
$$シモン$$
「And my $$ランカ$$ discs, too!」

629:t_007:30.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do it! To protect the songs of $$ランカ$$ and $$シェリル$$!」

629:t_007:31.en:
$$木下$$
「Yes! The $$銀河の妖精$$ and the Super Dimension Cinderella are the symbols of our hope!」

629:t_008:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What you're trying to do isn't just your own idea.」

629:t_008:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You are the First $$イノベイター$$. You could call yourself the forerunner of a new age in the $$ＡＤＷ$$.」

629:t_008:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
(Boy... As I thought, you show me the way.)

629:t_008:7.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Let's do this, $$刹那$$. We'll bring this situation under control and make contact with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

629:t_008:8.en:
$$刹那$$
「That is my mission... the $$イノベイター$$'s mission...!」

629:t_009:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Annihilation of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and the $$バジュラ$$ confirmed.」

629:t_009:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's a relief. We can't hold out through any more fighting...」

629:t_009:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「There's the damage to the pilots to worry about, but our machines are also badly worn down from the decisive battle at $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

629:t_009:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$スメラギ$$! New $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ approaching! The $$バジュラ$$ are with them!」

629:t_010:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You're kidding me! There's a limit to everything!」

629:t_010:1.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Having to take on a swarm this huge...」

629:t_010:2.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Gather your fighting spirit! If we fall back here, the main body of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ will reach Earth and the colonies!」

629:t_010:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Easy for you to say! But this is really...!」

629:t_011:1.en:
$$シェリル$$
(If the $$バジュラ$$ and the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are living in symbiosis, then surely the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ have a will too...)

629:t_011:2.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Please, $$バジュラ$$... Listen to our song, and then...)

629:t_012:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Damn! The $$クォーター$$ is being targeted!」

629:t_012:3.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Please understand, $$バジュラ$$... We don't want to fight you...)

629:t_013:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Did their song reach them?」

629:t_013:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「This is the only chance we'll get...!」

629:t_014:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「With the Raiser System, I'll create a region of shared consciousness in a high concentration of GN particles!」

629:t_014:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But the $$ダブルオーライザー$$ has its limits...!」

629:t_014:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「We have no choice but to do it!」

629:t_015:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「Here I go! $$トランザムバースト$$!」

629:t_016:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(I'm counting on you, $$刹那$$. Everything depends on your dialogue with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...!)

629:t_018:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The $$ダブルオーライザー$$ is being eroded by the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$!」

629:t_019:0.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Don't, $$ティエリア$$! If you use $$脳量子波$$ in a place like that!」

629:t_019:1.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「Now you're the one the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ will...!」

629:t_020:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You idiot, $$ティエリア$$! Are you going to sacrifice yourself!?」

629:t_020:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Hang on! I'm coming now!!」

629:t_020:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Take care of $$刹那$$ before me!」

629:t_021:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「For the sake of dialogue...! For humanity's future, I can't let $$刹那$$ be lost!」

uncertain: 629:t_007:10: 本当ならば rendered 'if things were as they should be' (could also be read 'if the truth be told').
629:t_008:6: Graham's 少年 rendered 'Boy' (no precedent in corpus).
629:t_008:3: ファースト・イノベイター = 'First $$イノベイター$$' (no glossary entry for the compound).
629:t_007:30: ランカさん達 rendered 'the songs of Ranka and Sheryl' (達 read as Sheryl + Ranka, matching 彼女達 in Ledo's line).
629:t_007:25: せっかくの = 'rare duet'; ライザーシステム written plain 'Raiser System' (no token).
629:t_021:0: やらせる = 'be lost' (Tieria: cannot let Setsuna be killed/lost).
